scope: Published audition plus six representative local cases and source native-loop evidence

claims.claim: Older audition is interactive and handles later questions
claims.finding: Initial ten-second whole audio request followed by silent packets; third question truncated.

claims.claim: Repeated decoder restart loses audio duration
claims.finding: 100 chunks: 2.3125-second loss becomes 0.023125 seconds with bounded context.

claims.claim: Adding two A100s alone solves processing speed
claims.finding: Mean S1 1.38 seconds, packet RTF 2.92; speech mean 0.36 seconds.

claims.claim: The H100/CUDA-graph configuration keeps up with paced input
claims.finding: Mean S1 0.245781 s; p95 0.305858 s; maximum queue delay 0.000267 s.

claims.claim: Recovered question terms prove good answers
claims.finding: Generic prompt invents finance access; capability control gives incomplete responses and unsupported standard-ratio claims.

failure_taxonomy.mode: Whole-file input and clipped final question
Eager Thinker processing slower than packet clock
Invented access and partial budget replies

inferences.finding: The remaining silence reflects listening states and buffer underruns as well as codec outputs. Fraction attributable to each mechanism is not established by a single amplitude threshold.

open_questions.finding: How much of the speed gain comes from H100 hardware versus CUDA graphs? They changed together.
Can the same configuration sustain real microphone interaction beyond this recorded software-transport test?

recommendations.action: Use paced complete input, bounded decoding and warmed graph-enabled fast configuration
recommendations.success_criterion: S1 processing below 480 ms and no accumulating input queue; preserve measured replay gaps.

recommendations.action: Evaluate per-question grounded replies and acoustic speech, including STOP behavior
recommendations.success_criterion: All requests receive complete relevant audible responses with no invented external capabilities.
